title: A Fixed-Backbone Exclusion for Length-70 Binary (9,1) Covering Sequences
description: Preprint, code, and reproducible certificates for a fixed-backbone theorem in the binary (9,1) covering-sequence problem. For an explicit 64-edge support, every connected nonnegative integral circulation of total mass 70 has overlap at most 61. A complete finite classification retains 188 residual flows and proves that the eight connected overlap-61 completions are all non-covers. Consequently, every valid length-70 cover has backbone overlap at most 60. This does not construct or exclude a length-70 covering sequence and does not change the known bounds 62 <= L(9,1) <= 71.
